desc: The Second Century is a double-barreled self-loading pistol. Structurally, it consists of two Colt M1911 pistols connected by side surfaces into one. It was created and produced by the weapons company Arsenal Firearms. The development of this pistol took six months of work, presented in the spring of 2012. Fires two bullets at the same time in one shot. Caliber .45 ACP.
